description: Shared verdicts for the pull_request concurrency rule. crates/norn-skeleton-guard/src/ci/mod.rs (concurrency_error) and verification/coverage-v1/validate.py (validate_pull_request_concurrency) must both reach `expect` for every case. A case's workflow is `on` followed by `concurrency` (null: none). A case with `source` holds that workflow's exact checked-in text.

cases.name: codeql.yml as checked in
cases.on:
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: "23 4 * * 1"
  workflow_dispatch:

cases.name: ci-policy.yml as checked in
cases.on:
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
  pull_request_target:
  # Posting, editing or deleting `/approve-gates` re-runs trusted-policy for that PR.
  issue_comment:
    types: [created, edited, deleted]
  # Branch heads are checked by their pull_request run; a branch push run
  # would duplicate the full gate on the same commit.
  push:
    branches: [main]
  merge_group:
  workflow_dispatch:

cases.name: folded multi-line group
cases.on: on: pull_request

cases.name: out of scope: pull_request_target without concurrency
cases.on: on: pull_request_target

cases.name: out of scope: pull_request_target with an unconditional cancel
cases.on:
on:
  pull_request_target:
  issue_comment:

cases.name: out of scope: push and workflow_run list
cases.on: on: [push, workflow_run]

cases.name: out of scope: workflow_run mapping
cases.on:
on:

    types: [requested]

cases.name: pull_request string without concurrency
cases.on: on: pull_request

cases.name: pull_request in a list without concurrency
cases.on: on: [push, pull_request]

cases.name: pull_request mapping without concurrency
